India Nears Decision on 114 Rafale Fighter Jet Deal

India is aiming to finalize a deal for 114 Rafale fighter jets by the end of the current financial year, according to Defence Secretary Rajesh Kumar Singh. Reports indicate Singh stated the procurement cycle should conclude before the end of the year.
